title: Texture Presets
description: A client side mod that allows you to make custom Texture presets.
body:
Texture Presets adds a simple but powerful preset system to Minecraft's resource pack menu. Save your current resource pack selection as a named preset, and load it back with a single click — no more manually enabling and reordering packs every time you switch between setups.
Perfect for players who frequently switch between different resource pack combinations, whether for screenshots, recording, or just different playstyles.
Features:

Save any resource pack selection as a named preset
Load presets directly into the vanilla resource pack menu
Rename and delete presets
All presets are stored locally in a simple JSON file
Lightweight client-side only mod — no server needed
